record.reason: No protection layers exist for the combined fire/water/decomposition scenario; this passive engineered layer removes the heating and water-contact causes at the source, addressing all linked deviations simultaneously.

record.action: Install fire-rated thermal insulation and water-diversion shielding on tote storage racks in LOC-G-WAREHOUSE to prevent external fire heating and washdown water contact with totes in S-TOTES.

record.action: Fit a deadhead pressure switch on the PORTABLE-PUMP that automatically stops the pump when discharge pressure exceeds the hose design pressure, protecting the hose S-L-HOSE-MX-4~PORTABLE-PUMP.
record.reason: The scenario involves forklift impact kinking the hose, causing pump deadhead and hose rupture with no protective layers; a deadhead pressure switch on the pump provides an independent engineered layer that stops pressure build-up at the source.

record.action: Add an independent low-flow trip on the S-HOMOGENISER circulation line that closes the steam supply valve to the jacket.
record.reason: Closes the gap by removing the cause (heating without circulation) with an engineered layer independent of the flow control loop; no existing layer credited for the combined pressure, temperature, and flow deviation scenario.

record.action: Fit the portable pump with a case-temperature trip that shuts down the pump on excessive heat, covering all linked sections S-L-HOSE-MX-1, S-L-HOSE-MX-3, S-L-HOSE-MX-4.
record.reason: No layers for combined thermal load; a single independent pump thermal trip addresses deadhead heating, friction heating, and fire impingement across all sections.

record.action: Install dedicated keyed couplings for each material hose at connections for sections S-L-HOSE-MX-3 and S-L-HOSE-MX-4 to prevent wrong hose connection.
record.reason: No layers for misconnection causing reverse flow; unique mechanical couplings remove the cause (wrong connection) and are superior to procedural checks.

record.action: Install an automatic high-level trip on mixing tank MX-2 that stops the portable pump used in procedure P-G-CHARGE-4 when the level exceeds the maximum fill height.
record.reason: The scenario involves multiple procedural deviations (skipped verification, overfill, no agitator) with no protective layers; an independent engineered level trip on MX-2 directly prevents overfilling regardless of operator action, addressing the largest risk contributor.

record.action: Install automatic high-level trips on both MX-2 and MX-4 that stop the portable pump used in P-G-CHARGE-4 when the tank level exceeds the maximum fill height.
record.reason: The scenario involves overfilling either tank by leaving the portable pump running too long with a loose lid, and no layers exist; high-level trips on both tanks directly stop the pump at the source, preventing spills and indoor vapour accumulation.

record.action: Add a tote-content verification interlock on the charging line to MX-2 that requires a matching tote ID scan before the portable pump can start, using the tote identification system for S-TOTES.
record.reason: The scenario stems from charging a tote with an undocumented reactive combination (KOH emulsifier and PDMS); an engineered verification interlock prevents the wrong tote from being connected, removing the cause rather than relying on operator vigilance.

record.action: Install an independent high-pressure safety trip on MX-2 that closes the jacket heating medium supply valve and opens a vent on overpressure, independent of the temperature control loop.
record.reason: The scenario combines wrong material charge, uncontrolled jacket heating (temperature control failure), and loose lid with no protective layers; an independent high-pressure trip on MX-2 directly mitigates the overpressure consequence regardless of the initiating cause.

record.action: Install passive fire protection (intumescent coating or thermal insulation) on tote storage in LOC-G-WAREHOUSE to limit heat transfer to SIH fluid in totes during external fire.
record.reason: No layer exists for fire-induced Si-H bond cleavage; passive thermal protection removes the heating cause at the source, preventing hydrogen release without relying on active systems.

record.action: Install an independent inline composition analyzer (e.g., densitometer or spectrometer) on the S-FILLING-LINE feed at LOC-G-BUILDING to verify chemical identity before filling.
record.reason: No layer exists for incorrect feed; an independent analyzer provides an engineered detection layer that acts on the composition deviation directly, superior to procedural checks which rely on human action.

record.action: Install a pressure safety valve on the S-FILLING-LINE that relieves to a closed containment system (e.g., catch tank) to prevent rupture and release into LOC-G-BUILDING.
record.reason: Provides an independent engineered pressure relief layer where none exists; relieves overpressure from downstream blockage directly at the filling line.

record.action: Add an independent high-temperature trip on the S-HOMOGENISER that closes the steam supply valve to the jacket on excessive temperature.
record.reason: Removes the cause (continued heating during stagnation) with an engineered trip independent of the temperature control loop; no existing layer credited.

record.action: Revise the S-FILLING-LINE charging procedure to require a documented material certificate-of-analysis match verification before opening the feed valve.
record.reason: Addresses the root cause (incorrect feed or cross-connection) with a procedural barrier; no engineered layer exists and procedural check is feasible for batch transfers.

record.action: Implement a mandatory dual-operator material identification check at P-G-CHARGE-3 before connecting the hose to S-L-HOSE-MX-1, using tagged hose-material matching.
record.reason: Prevents operator error (wrong material charging) with a procedural barrier at the charging point; no engineered layer exists and the action uses existing P-G-CHARGE-3 and S-L-HOSE-MX-1 IDs.

record.action: Install a high-temperature alarm and automatic portable pump shutdown on hose section S-L-HOSE-MX-1 to prevent phase change from temperature excursion.
record.reason: No protection layers exist; this engineered trip removes the cause (temperature rise) before phase change occurs, preferred over relief or procedure.

record.action: Provide a fixed water-spray deluge system for the portable pump operating area at LOC-G-BUILDING to cool hose and pump during external fire.
record.reason: No protection against external fire; a deluge system directly mitigates the fire hazard on the pump assembly at the named location.

record.action: Install a pressure safety valve on hose section S-L-HOSE-MX-3 downstream of valve P-G-CHARGE-3, set below hose rupture pressure.
record.reason: No layers for overpressure from valve misposition; an independent relief valve removes the hazard (overpressure) regardless of operator error.

record.action: Equip totes in S-TOTES with fire-rated pressure relief devices that maintain function during external fire exposure at LOC-G-WAREHOUSE.
record.reason: No layer exists for fire-induced overpressure; a fire-rated relief device provides an independent engineered safeguard that operates even when totes are heated, directly addressing the pressure-exceedance consequence.
